whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Has Your Site Been Left to Its Own Devices?
whatIs.paragraph1: Your website went live with great excitement, but what's next? Have software updates been pending for months, are plugins failing, and does no one know when the last backup was taken?
whatIs.paragraph2: A neglected website is like a neglected vehicle; it will eventually break down, and usually at the most critical moments (like a campaign or launch). A site crash doesn't just damage your reputation; it directly hits your sales.
whatIs.paragraph3: As Sybor Digital, we become your technical team working silently in the background of your site. With proactive maintenance, instant security patches, and 24/7 monitoring, we ensure the lights of your digital branch never go out.

physical.title: Active Website Owners
physical.description: I want to hand over regular maintenance to professionals before waiting for my site to slow down, throw errors, or get hacked.

startup.title: Agencies and Designers
startup.description: I want to free myself from the technical maintenance and support burden of the sites I deliver to my clients and hand this process over to a reliable team.

growing.title: E-Commerce Managers
growing.description: Even a minute of downtime for my site means thousands in losses. I want continuous monitoring and a guarantee of instant technical intervention.

global.title: Entrepreneurs With No Time
global.description: I need to focus on growing my business. I don't want to deal with technical details like server errors, plugin updates, or broken links.

whatWeDo.label: How We Help You
whatWeDo.title: We Intervene Before Issues Turn Into Crises
whatWeDo.paragraph1: We transition your site from a 'fix when broken' structure to a 'never breaks' structure. We regularly update your CMS infrastructure, themes, and plugins every month by running them through compatibility tests.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: We never leave your data to chance. Thanks to our automated, encrypted, and cloud-based backup systems; even if things go wrong, we restore your site to its most current and flawless state in minutes.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: If your site goes offline (downtime) for even a second, our systems notify us instantly. In emergencies, we provide guaranteed and lightning-fast technical intervention under a Service Level Agreement (SLA).
whatWeDo.cardDescription: All the technical support needed for your site to run fast and uninterrupted 365 days a year.

stock.title: Continuous Speed (Performance) Optimization

seo.title: Uninterrupted Uptime Monitor
seo.description: We check whether your site is live every minute. When a server-related crash occurs, we know about it before you do.

admin.title: Priority (VIP) Tech Support
admin.description: When you have a technical request, you don't wait in a support queue. We provide instant solutions with guaranteed SLA response times under our agreement.

whyUs.label: Why Sybor Digital?
whyUs.title: We Own Your Site Like It's Our Own
whyUs.subtitle: A true technology partner offering more than cliché support ticket systems.

reason1.title: Proactive Approach Not Waiting for a Crisis
reason1.description: We are not mechanics 'called when the site crashes'. By continuously monitoring systems, we solve problems in the background before they reach the crisis stage.

reason2.title: Contracted Fast Response (SLA)
reason2.description: We know time is money. In urgent technical crises, we don't say 'We'll get back to you ASAP'; we intervene within the clear timeframe stated in the contract.

reason3.title: Transparent and Clear Reporting
reason3.description: What updates did we make to your site that month, how many attacks did we block, where are the backups? We simplify and report all technical details for you.

reason4.title: Platform-Agnostic Expertise
reason4.description: Whether your site is WordPress, Next.js, or Webflow; we offer advanced support suitable for any infrastructure, independent of technology.

reason5.title: No More Surprise Costs
reason5.description: We do not issue separate invoices for every technical fix. With our fixed monthly maintenance packages, you can clearly forecast your budget.

reason6.title: Developer Reflex
reason6.description: Unlike ordinary support teams, we are software developers from the ground up. We analyze and resolve even the most complex code bugs you encounter.

process.label: Process
process.title: How Do We Take Over Your Site?
process.subtitle: Our transparent onboarding process for a seamless transition.

discovery.title: Technical Check-Up & Audit
discovery.description: Before taking over your site, we deeply analyze its code structure, server status, security vulnerabilities, and speed, generating a health report.

design.title: Improvement & Emergency Intervention
design.description: If we identify critical vulnerabilities or errors threatening your site's operation during the audit, we quickly repair them and stabilize the system.

development.title: Initiating the Continuous Maintenance Cycle
development.description: We activate our automated backup and security shields; we start our regular update and optimization routines.

launch.title: Priority Support & Reporting
launch.description: We fulfill your instant content/design revision requests and report your site's performance data to you at the end of each month.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about web maintenance and support processes.

delivery.question: When and how can we start the maintenance agreement?
delivery.answer: After sharing your system information with us, we complete a detailed technical check-up within 1-2 days and immediately initiate the active protection process.

pricing.question: How are monthly maintenance and support costs determined?
pricing.answer: We offer custom, fixed-price packages based on your site's infrastructure (e.g., corporate site vs. e-commerce site dynamics differ), traffic volume, and requested instant response (SLA) times.

revisions.question: Are minor content/visual changes included in the monthly maintenance package?
revisions.answer: Yes, depending on the scope of the package you choose, we handle your minor revision requests (text changes, adding a new blog, visual updates, etc.) up to a certain number of hours each month at no extra charge.

maintenance.question: If my site crashes or gets hacked, how quickly do you respond?
maintenance.answer: It is subject to the SLA (Service Level Agreement) times in our contract. For standard sites, we guarantee intervention within 1-2 hours during business hours, and for critical e-commerce sites, 24/7 instant intervention (depending on the package).

migration.question: Another agency/developer built my site. Do you still provide maintenance services?
migration.answer: Absolutely yes. Before taking over your existing code structure and server, we conduct a detailed audit, get to know the system, and then professionally assume responsibility.

mobile.question: Where are the backups you take stored, and is the data on my site safe?
mobile.answer: Your backups are stored entirely independent of the main server hosting your website, highly secured and encrypted on cloud servers in different geographic locations.
